name: Sideload any app (APK you provide)
summary: Installs an APK you downloaded — great for apps the TV store doesn't carry (e.g. a different browser, Jellyfin, Kodi, F-Droid). reclaim never downloads anything; you point it at a file you obtained yourself.
notes: --package is the app's id, used so `reclaim undo` can uninstall it cleanly.
Only sideload APKs from sources you trust (official sites / F-Droid).

steps.label: Provide the APK with --apk and the app id with --package for clean undo.
